facts.fact: The Sahara and Sahel Observatory states that it trained the Libyan Agricultural Research Center, which supports the Agriculture Ministry in monitoring campaigns, on 26 February to 1 March 2024 in using the MISBAR, MISLAND and GUETCROP Earth Observation tools, with a roadmap for Libyan use cases to follow.

LBY.note: The workshop concerns Earth Observation for agriculture, not digital policy.
